entries.en: The bus struggled along the twisty mountain road.
entries.zh: 公共汽车艰难地沿着弯弯曲曲的山路行驶。

entries.en: The deadline is unchangeable because the venue closes that evening.
entries.zh: 截止时间不能改变，因为场地那天晚上就要关闭。

entries.en: New lighting completed the room's transfiguration from gloomy cellar to welcoming studio.
entries.zh: 新的照明完成了房间的变貌，使阴暗的地窖成了温馨的工作室。

entries.en: The mood in the room was palpably tense.
entries.zh: 房间里的气氛明显很紧张。

entries.en: The dentist compared the radiographic images before examining the tooth.
entries.zh: 牙医在检查牙齿前比较了放射照相图像。

entries.en: The exhausted runner smiled wanly from the stretcher.
entries.zh: 担架上筋疲力尽的跑步者虚弱地笑了笑。

entries.en: She stared disbelievingly at the enormous repair bill.
entries.zh: 她难以置信地盯着那张金额巨大的维修账单。

entries.en: The two families shared the courtyard peaceably for years.
entries.zh: 两家人多年来一直和平地共用这个庭院。

entries.en: The crew gallantly fought the fire despite the spreading smoke.
entries.zh: 尽管烟雾不断蔓延，船员们仍勇敢地灭火。

entries.en: The critic disdainfully dismissed the painting as a clumsy imitation.
entries.zh: 评论家轻蔑地把这幅画斥为拙劣的仿制品。

entries.en: They chose white dinnerware for the wedding reception.
entries.zh: 他们为婚宴挑选了白色的整套餐具。

entries.en: The wetland lies along a major flyway for migrating geese.
entries.zh: 这片湿地位于雁类的一条主要候鸟迁徙路径上。

entries.en: The expedition's medical report recorded several cases of hypoxia.
entries.zh: 探险队的医疗报告记录了几例低氧症。

entries.en: The biologist investigated an atavistic trait in the new specimen.
entries.zh: 生物学家研究了这个新标本中的一项返祖性特征。

entries.en: A shill in the crowd loudly praised the salesman's worthless watches.
entries.zh: 人群中一个小贩的同伙大声夸赞着售货员那些不值钱的手表。

entries.en: The visiting poet gave a reading at the town's lyceum.
entries.zh: 来访的诗人在镇上的讲演厅举办了朗诵会。

entries.en: The hailstorm left dents across the parked cars.
entries.zh: 那场雹暴在停着的汽车上留下了许多凹痕。

entries.en: The renovated bathroom has a bidet beside the toilet.
entries.zh: 翻修后的浴室在马桶旁装有一个坐浴盆。

entries.en: The clinician noted otorrhea during the ear examination.
entries.zh: 临床医生在耳部检查时注意到了耳液溢。

entries.en: The collector hoped to repurchase the painting sold years earlier.
entries.zh: 收藏家希望买回多年前卖掉的那幅画。

entries.en: His hands jerked convulsively as the seizure began.
entries.zh: 发作开始时，他的双手痉挛性地抽动。

entries.en: The bigness of the hall surprised the visiting children.
entries.zh: 大厅之大让来访的孩子们感到惊讶。

entries.en: The character hides a reefer in an empty cigarette packet.
entries.zh: 这个人物把一支大麻卷烟藏在空烟盒里。

entries.en: The villagers refused to enter the accursed castle.
entries.zh: 村民们拒绝进入那座被诅咒的城堡。

entries.en: The shipyard builds seagoing vessels for long ocean voyages.
entries.zh: 这家造船厂建造适于远洋航行的船只。

entries.en: The plant uses chlorination as part of its water treatment process.
entries.zh: 这家工厂把用氯处理作为水处理流程的一部分。

entries.en: The chef sliced the terrine and served it with pickles.
entries.zh: 厨师把陶制盖碗食品切片，配上腌菜端了上来。

entries.en: The geologist collected metamorphic rock from the exposed ridge.
entries.zh: 地质学家从裸露的山脊采集了变质岩。

entries.en: The diagram traces the urethra from the bladder outward.
entries.zh: 示意图描绘了尿道从膀胱向外延伸的路径。

entries.en: The technician installed a suppressor to reduce electrical interference.
entries.zh: 技术员安装了一个抑制器来减少电气干扰。

entries.en: The critic explored the novel's homoerotic themes in her essay.
entries.zh: 评论家在文章中探讨了小说中同性恋爱的主题。

entries.en: The regime imprisoned any noncompliant who refused its demands.
entries.zh: 该政权把任何拒绝其要求的不顺从者都关进监狱。

entries.en: The medical paper describes feminization in a male patient.
entries.zh: 这篇医学论文描述了一位男性患者的女性化现象。

entries.en: The anthropologist studied fetishism in the community's religious practices.
entries.zh: 人类学家研究了这个群体宗教实践中的拜物教。

entries.en: The fruit mixture will jell as it cools.
entries.zh: 这种水果混合物冷却时会凝成胶状。

entries.en: We sheltered from the midday sun in the summerhouse.
entries.zh: 我们在凉亭里躲避正午的阳光。

entries.en: In this matrilineal community, family membership follows the mother's line.
entries.zh: 在这个母系社群中，家族归属沿母亲一系传承。

entries.en: The hotel clerk bowed politely to Signora Rossi.
entries.zh: 酒店职员礼貌地向罗西夫人鞠躬。

entries.en: Solving this puzzle takes more brainpower than I expected.
entries.zh: 解开这个谜题所需的脑力比我预想的多。

entries.en: The dancers achieved perfect synchronicity in the final sequence.
entries.zh: 舞者们在最后一段动作中达到了完美的同步。

entries.en: The manufacturer added a flame retardant to the fabric.
entries.zh: 制造商在织物中加入了阻燃剂。

entries.en: The factory will reprocess the rejected plastic into new pellets.
entries.zh: 工厂将把不合格的塑料再处理成新的颗粒。

entries.en: The exposed metal began to oxidise in the damp air.
entries.zh: 裸露的金属在潮湿的空气中开始氧化。

entries.en: The myth describes a river separating the living from the netherworld.
entries.zh: 这个神话描写了一条将生者与阴间隔开的河。

entries.en: The cottager tended a vegetable patch behind the little stone house.
entries.zh: 那位村民照料着小石屋后的一块菜地。

entries.en: The boxer took a hard punch to the breadbasket.
entries.zh: 拳击手的腹部挨了重重一拳。

entries.en: The pamphlet criticizes centralism for weakening local decision making.
entries.zh: 这本小册子批评中央集权制削弱了地方决策。

entries.en: The centenarian showed us photographs from her childhood.
entries.zh: 这位百岁老人给我们看了她童年时的照片。

entries.en: His immodest claim to have saved the entire project annoyed his colleagues.
entries.zh: 他不谦虚地声称自己挽救了整个项目，这让同事们很恼火。

entries.en: A piece of butterscotch stuck to the paper wrapper.
entries.zh: 一块奶油糖果粘在了包装纸上。

entries.en: A wooden rood hung above the chapel's entrance.
entries.zh: 小教堂入口上方悬挂着一尊木制的十字架基督像。

entries.en: She hung her burqa on a hook beside the door.
entries.zh: 她把蒙面长袍挂在门边的钩子上。

entries.en: The noisy rookery occupied the tallest trees beside the church.
entries.zh: 那片嘈杂的鸟类群栖处占据了教堂旁最高的几棵树。

entries.en: The driver brought the stanhope around to the front gate.
entries.zh: 车夫把单座敞篷轻便马车赶到了前门。

entries.en: The university opened a bioscience laboratory beside the botanical garden.
entries.zh: 大学在植物园旁开设了一个生物科学实验室。

entries.en: The laboratory analyzed the plant's psychoactive compounds.
entries.zh: 实验室分析了这种植物中对神经起特殊作用的化合物。

entries.en: The optical device allows precise focalization of the beam.
entries.zh: 这个光学装置可以使光束精确聚焦。

entries.en: The news made him gnash his teeth in frustration.
entries.zh: 这个消息让他懊恼得咬牙切齿。

entries.en: The fraudulent demonstration made the inventor a laughingstock.
entries.zh: 那场骗人的演示使发明家成了笑柄。

entries.en: The boatyard repaired our damaged hull over the winter.
entries.zh: 造船厂在冬季修好了我们受损的船体。

entries.en: The knight fastened the breastplate over a padded tunic.
entries.zh: 骑士把护胸甲扣在了有衬垫的长衣外。

entries.en: The flight was delayed for refueling and routine checks.
entries.zh: 航班因再加油和例行检查而延误。

entries.en: The nurse placed a clean bedpan within reach.
entries.zh: 护士把一个干净的便盆放在伸手可及的地方。

entries.en: The older children cruelly called him a crybaby.
entries.zh: 大一点的孩子们刻薄地叫他爱哭鬼。

entries.en: The archive contains letters written by a wealthy slaveholder.
entries.zh: 档案中存有一名富有的奴隶所有者写的信。

entries.en: The two rival candidates seemed surprisingly chummy at dinner.
entries.zh: 两位竞争候选人在晚餐时显得出奇地友好。

entries.en: The famous actor traveled incognito through the small coastal towns.
entries.zh: 这位著名演员隐姓埋名地游历了沿海的小镇。

entries.en: The grandmaster studied the chessboard before sacrificing a rook.
entries.zh: 这位国际象棋大师仔细看了棋盘，然后弃车。

entries.en: The engineer tested an admixture designed to improve the concrete.
entries.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于改善混凝土的掺和剂。

entries.en: Some knucklehead left the freezer door wide open.
entries.zh: 不知哪个蠢人把冷冻柜的门敞着没关。

entries.en: The traveling band spent a night in a sleepy little burg.
entries.zh: 巡演乐队在一个冷清的小镇住了一晚。

entries.en: The refugee recognized her former persecutor in the courtroom.
entries.zh: 这位难民在法庭上认出了曾经迫害她的人。

entries.en: Blue chicory flowers grew along the dusty roadside.
entries.zh: 蓝色的菊苣花生长在尘土飞扬的路边。

entries.en: The engine's propulsive force moved the boat against the current.
entries.zh: 发动机的推进力使船逆流前进。

entries.en: The village built new defenses after the spring inundation.
entries.zh: 春季淹水后，村庄修建了新的防御设施。

entries.en: The carpenter nailed a thin lath across the frame.
entries.zh: 木匠在框架上横钉了一根薄板条。

entries.en: She finished her signature with an elaborate curlicue.
entries.zh: 她在签名末尾加了一个繁复的花体卷曲笔画。

entries.en: A helical staircase winds around the tower's central column.
entries.zh: 一道螺旋状楼梯绕着塔的中央立柱盘旋而上。

entries.en: The farm replaced monoculture with a rotation of several crops.
entries.zh: 农场用几种作物的轮作替代了单一栽培。

entries.en: He cracked a filbert and tasted the kernel.
entries.zh: 他敲开一颗榛子，尝了尝果仁。

entries.en: The ceiling was painted with zodiacal symbols.
entries.zh: 天花板上绘有黄道带的符号。

entries.en: A sudden sunburst lit the valley between two rain showers.
entries.zh: 两阵雨之间突然露出的阳光照亮了山谷。

entries.en: His face turned ashy when he heard the crash.
entries.zh: 他听到撞击声时，脸色变得灰白。

entries.en: The museum's new waxwork looked remarkably like the singer.
entries.zh: 博物馆新添的蜡像与那位歌手极为相像。

entries.en: A mustachioed waiter with curled whiskers brought our coffee.
entries.zh: 一位留着鬈曲八字胡的侍者端来了我们的咖啡。

entries.en: The research team examined how the prion changed the protein's shape.
entries.zh: 研究团队考察了这种感染性蛋白质如何改变蛋白质的形状。

entries.en: The armored warhorse stamped beside the castle gate.
entries.zh: 披甲的军马在城门旁跺着蹄子。

entries.en: The group organized an evangelistic mission to the neighboring towns.
entries.zh: 这个团体组织了一次到邻近城镇的福音传道活动。

entries.en: She rubbed her eyes tiredly and closed the laptop.
entries.zh: 她疲倦地揉了揉眼睛，合上了笔记本电脑。

entries.en: The negotiator astutely noticed a weakness in the proposal.
entries.zh: 谈判者精明地注意到了提案中的一个弱点。

entries.en: The windstorm tore several branches from the old oak.
entries.zh: 暴风从那棵老橡树上刮断了几根树枝。

entries.en: A strong headwind slowed the aircraft on its return flight.
entries.zh: 强劲的逆风使飞机返航时减速了。

entries.en: The researcher compared the nonsteroidal compound with two steroid drugs.
entries.zh: 研究人员把这种非类固醇化合物与两种类固醇药物进行了比较。

entries.en: The navigator checked the chronometer before calculating the ship's longitude.
entries.zh: 领航员在计算船的经度前核对了航海精密时计。

entries.en: We measured the salt's solubility at three different temperatures.
entries.zh: 我们测量了这种盐在三个不同温度下的溶解度。

entries.en: The diagram marks a telomere at each end of the chromosome.
entries.zh: 图中在染色体的两端各标出了一个端粒。

entries.en: The epistolary novel tells its story entirely through letters.
entries.zh: 这部书信体小说完全通过信件讲述故事。

entries.en: The deer grazed unmolested in the protected meadow.
entries.zh: 鹿在受保护的草地上不受打扰地吃草。

entries.en: The trainee practiced intubation on a medical mannequin.
entries.zh: 实习人员在医学模拟人身上练习插管法。

entries.en: The canoeist steered carefully between the submerged rocks.
entries.zh: 划独木舟的人小心地在水下岩石之间掌舵前进。

entries.en: The artist carved a pattern into the dried calabash.
entries.zh: 艺术家在干葫芦上雕刻了一个图案。

entries.en: An icky layer of glue covered the jar's lid.
entries.zh: 罐盖上覆着一层黏糊糊的胶水。

entries.en: A countywide survey asked residents about bus services.
entries.zh: 一项全县调查询问了居民对公交服务的看法。

entries.en: A single garbanzo rolled from the bag onto the counter.
entries.zh: 一颗鹰嘴豆从袋子里滚到了操作台上。

entries.en: The illustration labels the fish's branchial structures.
entries.zh: 插图标出了这条鱼的鳃部结构。

entries.en: She bought a length of blue batik for a skirt.
entries.zh: 她买了一块蓝色蜡防印花布做裙子。

entries.en: The lock was devilishly difficult to open without the key.
entries.zh: 没有钥匙，这把锁难开得要命。

entries.en: The novel describes the king's decline into senility.
entries.zh: 小说描写了国王逐渐衰老的过程。

entries.en: The coach accused his opponent of gamesmanship after repeated deliberate delays.
entries.zh: 对方多次故意拖延后，教练指责其采用搅乱战术。

entries.en: The old medical chest contained a bottle of physic.
entries.zh: 旧药箱里放着一瓶泻药。

entries.en: The constitution promised untrammeled freedom of artistic expression.
entries.zh: 宪法承诺不受限制的艺术表达自由。

entries.en: She folded the silk negligee and placed it in a drawer.
entries.zh: 她叠好丝质女便服，把它放进抽屉。

entries.en: The audience listened in reverential silence as the elder spoke.
entries.zh: 长者发言时，听众怀着崇敬之情静静聆听。

entries.en: The bondsman signed the documents at the courthouse.
entries.zh: 保证人在法院签署了文件。

entries.en: The film stereotypically portrays every teenager as lazy and rebellious.
entries.zh: 这部电影带有成见地把每个青少年都描写成懒惰又叛逆的人。

entries.en: The students talked animatedly about their upcoming expedition.
entries.zh: 学生们兴致勃勃地谈论即将开始的探险。

entries.en: Her expression changed from disbelief to firm unbelief in his story.
entries.zh: 她的表情从难以置信变成了坚决不相信他的说法。

entries.en: The patient stargazer waited for the clouds to clear.
entries.zh: 那位耐心的观星者等着云层散去。

entries.en: The scan showed a gallstone near the duct.
entries.zh: 扫描显示导管附近有一颗胆结石。

entries.en: The fishermen spoke a local patois unfamiliar to visitors.
entries.zh: 渔民们说着一种来访者不熟悉的当地方言。

entries.en: A quilted counterpane covered the narrow guest bed.
entries.zh: 一床绗缝床罩盖在狭窄的客床上。

entries.en: The dressmaker added sleeves of pale green organza.
entries.zh: 裁缝加上了浅绿色透明硬纱制成的袖子。

entries.en: Floodwater washed away part of the roadbed.
entries.zh: 洪水冲走了部分路基。

entries.en: The team collected samples from the estuarine mud.
entries.zh: 研究小组从河口的泥中采集了样本。

entries.en: The technician measured the alkalinity of the water sample.
entries.zh: 技术员测量了水样的碱度。

entries.en: The warm apple strudel arrived with a jug of cream.
entries.zh: 热腾腾的苹果馅卷与一壶奶油一起端了上来。

entries.en: She accepted trusteeship of the fund after her brother resigned.
entries.zh: 她的兄弟辞职后，她接下了基金的托管人职责。

entries.en: The gardener planted the shrubs symmetrically around the fountain.
entries.zh: 园丁围着喷泉对称地种下了灌木。

entries.en: The children sprinkled sugared almonds over the cake.
entries.zh: 孩子们把糖衣杏仁撒在蛋糕上。

entries.en: The ingredient label lists aspartame among the sweeteners.
entries.zh: 配料表把天冬甜素列在甜味剂中。

entries.en: She stepped daintily across the polished ballroom floor.
entries.zh: 她轻盈优美地走过舞厅光亮的地板。

entries.en: He spoke nostalgically about the cinema where he once worked.
entries.zh: 他怀旧地谈起自己曾经工作过的电影院。

entries.en: The therapist discussed the patient's phobic reaction to enclosed spaces.
entries.zh: 治疗师讨论了患者对封闭空间的病态性恐惧反应。

entries.en: The merger required a reapportionment of costs among the departments.
entries.zh: 合并后需要在各部门之间重新分摊费用。

entries.en: The gunsmith repaired the broken mechanism in the antique rifle.
entries.zh: 枪炮工修好了古董步枪里损坏的机械装置。

entries.en: A lace wristband edged the sleeve of her blouse.
entries.zh: 她衬衫的袖边饰有蕾丝袖口。

entries.en: The revolution replaced the monarchical government with a republic.
entries.zh: 革命用共和国取代了君主政体的政府。

entries.en: The old manufactory produced fine porcelain for wealthy households.
entries.zh: 这家旧制造厂为富裕家庭生产精美的瓷器。

entries.en: The curtains gave the room a bright, summery feeling.
entries.zh: 窗帘让房间有了一种明亮的夏日气息。

entries.en: Workers will sandblast the rust from the iron gate.
entries.zh: 工人们将用喷砂法清除铁门上的锈。

entries.en: Thousands of fans filled the coliseum for the final match.
entries.zh: 数千名球迷涌进大体育馆观看决赛。

entries.meaningZh: 吐露心事消除思想负担
entries.en: She needed a trusted friend to unburden herself to.
entries.zh: 她需要一位可信赖的朋友来倾诉心事、减轻负担。

entries.en: A wooden guidepost pointed toward the mountain shelter.
entries.zh: 一个木制路标指向了山间避难所。

entries.en: The judge took the request under advisement.
entries.zh: 法官对这项请求予以审慎考虑。

entries.en: The keeper checked each ungulate before opening the pasture gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员在打开牧场大门前检查了每只有蹄类动物。

entries.en: That brainless decision left the team without any spare equipment.
entries.zh: 那个无头脑的决定使团队没有任何备用设备。

entries.en: She glanced worriedly at the gathering storm clouds.
entries.zh: 她焦虑地看了一眼聚集起来的暴风雨云。

entries.en: The officer placed the confiscated switchblade in an evidence bag.
entries.zh: 警察把没收的弹簧小折刀放进了证物袋。

entries.en: The valley's broad shape shows the effects of glaciation.
entries.zh: 山谷宽阔的形态显示了冰川作用的影响。

entries.en: She knitted a soft scarf from pale blue mohair.
entries.zh: 她用浅蓝色马海毛织了一条柔软的围巾。

entries.en: The laboratory keeps consumable supplies in the lower cupboard.
entries.zh: 实验室把可消耗的用品放在下层橱柜里。

entries.en: The charming heartbreaker left another disappointed lover behind.
entries.zh: 那个迷人的负心人又留下了一位失望的恋人。

entries.en: The actress adopted a matronly manner for the role.
entries.zh: 这位女演员为角色采用了成熟女性的稳重举止。

entries.en: The specialist investigated her hypersensitivity to the medication.
entries.zh: 专科医生研究了她对这种药物的过敏反应。

entries.en: The nurse examined the patient's underarm rash.
entries.zh: 护士检查了患者腋下的皮疹。

entries.en: The two clocks remained in synchrony throughout the experiment.
entries.zh: 两只钟在整个实验过程中保持同步。

entries.en: The collector displayed a medieval German heller under glass.
entries.zh: 收藏家把一枚中世纪德国小铜币陈列在玻璃罩下。

entries.en: The experiment compared the refractive properties of two lenses.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两片透镜的折射特性。

entries.en: The gloomy prognosticator predicted another year of failed harvests.
entries.zh: 那个悲观的预言者预言庄稼又将歉收一年。

entries.en: The lawyer asked whether the alleged act was an indictable offense.
entries.zh: 律师询问被指控的行为是否属于可提起公诉的罪行。

entries.en: The door closed with a heavy metallic clunk.
entries.zh: 门关上时发出了一声沉闷的金属响声。

entries.en: She answered the door in a faded housecoat.
entries.zh: 她穿着一件褪色的家常服来开门。

entries.en: A stagehand moved the painted backdrop during the interval.
entries.zh: 一位舞台工作人员在幕间休息时移动了彩绘布景。

entries.en: The survivor spoke movingly about the strangers who had helped her.
entries.zh: 幸存者动人地讲述了帮助过她的陌生人的故事。

entries.en: The cat slipped noiselessly through the open doorway.
entries.zh: 猫无声地溜过敞开的门口。

entries.en: The museum restored a damaged panzer for its military exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆为军事展修复了一辆受损的坦克。

entries.en: They roasted the breadfruit over a bed of glowing coals.
entries.zh: 他们把面包果放在一层发红的炭火上烤。

entries.en: The course helped me unlearn the ideas I had accepted without question.
entries.zh: 这门课帮助我抛掉了那些曾不加质疑就接受的想法。

entries.en: I guessed the murderer halfway through the whodunit.
entries.zh: 这部侦探小说读到一半时，我就猜出了凶手。

entries.en: She accepted the librarianship at a small coastal college.
entries.zh: 她接受了沿海一所小型学院的图书馆长职位。

entries.en: The specialist reviewed the patient's history of rhinitis.
entries.zh: 专科医生查看了患者的鼻炎病史。

entries.en: The botanists plan to hybridize two hardy rose varieties.
entries.zh: 植物学家们计划将两个耐寒玫瑰品种进行杂交。

entries.en: He declined the episcopate and remained a parish priest.
entries.zh: 他谢绝了主教之职，继续担任堂区神父。

entries.en: The students monitored acidification by recording changes in the solution's pH.
entries.zh: 学生们通过记录溶液酸碱度的变化来监测酸化过程。

entries.en: Don't sass the coach when she explains the rules.
entries.zh: 教练解释规则时不要顶嘴。

entries.en: The child tapped a simple tune on the xylophone.
entries.zh: 孩子在木琴上敲奏了一段简单的曲调。

entries.en: The layout uses the available space maximally.
entries.zh: 这种布局最大限度地利用了现有空间。

entries.en: The concert reached radio and television audiences through a simulcast.
entries.zh: 这场音乐会通过广播和电视同时联播，面向听众和观众播出。

entries.en: The child tossed the beanbag into the painted circle.
entries.zh: 孩子把豆子袋扔进了画好的圆圈。

entries.en: The timing of the rainfall proved determinative for the harvest.
entries.zh: 降雨的时间被证明对收成起了决定性作用。

entries.en: The model includes a stochastic term to represent measurement noise.
entries.zh: 模型包含一个随机项，用来表示测量噪声。

entries.en: A small mouse disappeared behind the woodpile.
entries.zh: 一只小老鼠消失在木料堆后。

entries.en: The portrait shows the dauphin beside his father, the king.
entries.zh: 画像中，法国皇太子在他的父亲国王身旁。

entries.en: The farmer checked the peaches for ripeness before picking them.
entries.zh: 农民采摘桃子前检查了它们的成熟程度。

entries.en: The gallery attracted a moneyed crowd on opening night.
entries.zh: 开幕之夜，画廊吸引了一群有钱人。

entries.en: The contract places limits on the transferability of the membership.
entries.zh: 合同对会员资格的可转让性作出了限制。

entries.en: The sermon warned against the worldliness of chasing wealth alone.
entries.zh: 讲道告诫人们不要抱有一味追逐财富的俗心。

entries.en: Overproduction forced the factory to store unsold goods in rented warehouses.
entries.zh: 生产过剩迫使工厂把卖不出去的货物存进租来的仓库。

entries.en: The performance received a laudatory review in the local newspaper.
entries.zh: 这场演出在当地报纸上获得了一篇赞美的评论。

entries.en: The farmer inspected the wheat for signs of smut.
entries.zh: 农民检查了小麦是否有黑穗病的迹象。
